name: Two overlapping trips that overstay are listed as one overstay of 11 days

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2024-04-10&fresh=1 (pins today to 2024-04-10 and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2024-01-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2024-04-05 (data-testid=trip-exit)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2024-03-25 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2024-04-10 (data-testid=trip-exit)
The overstay list (data-testid=overstay-detail) has exactly one item, and it reads 'Overstay from 2024-03-31 to 2024-04-10 (11 days).'
